title: Toasts Abilities
description: A data pack that adds 7 different custom classes, each with a ability, ultimate and a passive to improve combat. They are: Wind, Electric, Space, Sculk, Life, Metal and Oceanic
body:
# **Description**
A data pack that adds 7 different custom classes, each with an ability, ultimate and a passive to improve combat. They are: 
- Wind
- Electric
- Space
- Sculk
- Life
- Metal
- Oceanic

To use the ability you **MUST** have selectect that class before hand and it is only **ONE PERSON PER CLASS**

# **Recommended**
I recommend using a mod called command keys to rebind the functions you want to keybinds of your choice

# **Thanks**
Many thanks to legendobos for helping test this in multiplayer. Thanks for checking out my data pack and I hope you enjoy! :)

# **Links**
1. [Command Keys](https://modrinth.com/mod/commandkeys)
2. [Github](https://github.com/Sirfronkenhiem/Toasts-Abilities/tree/main)
